newsitem.title: USA: Cross-Continent Auto IPO terms amended.
newsitem.headline: Cross-Continent Auto IPO terms amended.

text.p: Cross-Continent Auto Retailers Inc plans to offer 3,675,000 shares in its initial public offering at an estimated price range of $12 to $14 per share, according to an amended filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commision.
The company, previously known as Cross-Country Auto Retailers Inc, had initially filed for an offering of 3,125,000 shares with a price range of $15 to $17 per share.

Morgan Stanley & Co is the lead underwriter on the offering, which is tentatively scheduled to make its debut on the New York Stock Exchange during the week of September 30. The proposed stock symbol is "XC".
Cross-Continent owns and operates six franchised automobile dealerships in the Amarillo, Texas, and Oklahoma City, Okla., markets.
